snippet.title: Slumbering Woods - Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Slumbering Woods is a cosy mushroom-planting exploration adventure set in a mysterious fungal forest.

The free demo launches on Steam on March 6, 8am PT / March 7, early morning (AU).

Restore spreading wild growth, experiment with unusual mushrooms, upgrade your hut, and help the village through the changing seasons. Explore hand-crafted environments, solve light environmental puzzles, and uncover the quiet story hidden beneath the canopy.

Wishlist and play the demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3243350/Slumbering_Woods/

If you enjoy what you see, consider sharing the trailer and following the project for updates.
